name: DCA Festival Marketplaces (Lunar New Year / Food & Wine / Holidays): Garlic Noodles, Char Siu Pork & Rice / Mac & Cheese
brandOrRestaurant: DCA Festival Marketplace Booths (Performance Corridor · Disney California Adventure)
searchKeywords: dca festival of holidays sip and savor
whyItWorks: DCA's Sip and Savor marketplace booths feature small-plate portions (ideal for Crohn's!); the safest tabs are always the soft noodle dishes (Longevity Noodles / Mac & Cheese with lactase), Char Siu BBQ Pork with White Rice, and Braised Beef Short Rib with Mashed Potatoes.
prepOrOrderInstructions: On your Sip and Savor Pass, pick the Braised Short Rib & Potato Purée, Char Siu Pork & Rice, Roasted Turkey Slider, or Creamy Mac & Cheese (with lactase)—skip spicy Mala/Sichuan chili noodles and citrus-heavy mocktails.
watchOuts: Check booth placards for lemon/lime/grapefruit juices in festival mocktails and spicy chili oils
